analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.intro: How the team and the store are doing, from the figures the platform keeps hour by hour.
analytics.utcNote: Figures are of whole days in UTC that are already over, up to yesterday. Today is in the My performance box of the inbox.

kpi.failed: This figure could not be loaded.

chart.label: {caption}. The numbers are in the table that follows.

volume.title: Conversation volume
volume.caption: Conversations that came in and conversations resolved, each day

agents.title: Team performance
agents.caption: Conversations resolved and first response time of each person
agents.empty: Nobody resolved a conversation in this period.

export.title: Export the figures
export.description: A day-by-day file of the period on the screen: from {from} to {to} (the last day not included), days in UTC.
export.queued: The file is being prepared. It will be ready in the exports center in a moment.

reports.title: Scheduled reports
reports.intro: Each report emails a file of the figures on its own schedule, for the period that just ended.
reports.readOnly: You can see the reports. To make, change or pause one you also need permission to export analytics.
reports.empty: There are no scheduled reports yet.
reports.utcNote: A report covers whole days in UTC. The hour is in the time zone chosen for the report.

form.description: The report sends a file of the figures by email. Whoever saves it answers for what it sends.
form.name: Name
form.scheduleHint: A weekly report goes out on Mondays and a monthly one on the 1st, from the chosen hour on.
form.recipientsHint: One per line, or separated by commas. Up to {max}. They do not see each other.

problems.name: Write a name for the report.
problems.recipients: Write between one and {max} valid addresses, each one once.
problems.timezone: Choose a time zone from the list.
problems.frequency: Choose how often the report is sent.
problems.format: Choose a file type from the list.

delete.title: Delete this report?
delete.body: {name} will stop being sent. The files already sent are not affected.

searches.title: Searches
searches.note: What was searched in the last {days} days, today included. The box that opens as you type counts only the results you open.
searches.empty: Nobody has searched in this period.
searches.caption: Searches, searches that found nothing and results opened, for each kind of search

gaps.title: Products people looked for and did not find
gaps.empty: Every search of the catalog found something.
